# ActiveNerds

> ActiveNerds is the go-to destination for AI/ML, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps professionals — sharp technical coverage woven with genuinely useful, non-preachy fitness and wellness content for desk-bound tech pros.

- [Blog](https://www.activenerds.com/blog): Blog index
- [Search](https://www.activenerds.com/search): Search all content
- [About](https://www.activenerds.com/about): About ActiveNerds
- [Contact](https://www.activenerds.com/contact): Contact information
- [FAQ](https://www.activenerds.com/faq): Frequently asked questions
